comment: JP 1.27 (BCJS30089) game-address instruction patches. 'patches' holds the HSG_FPS lines (guard g_hsg_fps; runtime libs/system/hsg_fps.c, JP address set), each mapped from the US 1.03 line by side-by-side disassembly; pipeline-jp127.toml lifts with --insn-patches this file. 'us_1_03_mapping' maps each US 1.03 patch (config/insn-patches-1.03.json) to its JP address (tools/jp_addr_map.py, fps lines by disassembly); the HSG_TWEAKS and ultrawide-cull lines are still not applied (their runtime side is off on JP, libs/system/hsg_program.c). Note US 0x1B150 has a second JP copy at 0x1B3D8 that needs no patch: it follows stb 1 to +4 at 0x1B3A0.

fps (HSG_FPS, hsg_fps.c): App_SetSlowMotion (start): r10 = K (drops S=0; Main_Tick sets S=-1 on start) [JP 1.27; US 1.03 line 0x00018B2C]

fps (HSG_FPS, hsg_fps.c): Main_Tick: always take the fixed-step + interpolation path (was: slow motion active) [JP 1.27; US 1.03 line 0x0001B150]

fps (HSG_FPS, hsg_fps.c): Main_Tick: renderer step flag 1 on logic ticks, as in slow motion (the interp path after the logic phases steps the renderer clock a second time) [JP 1.27; US 1.03 line 0x0001B6DC]
fps (HSG_FPS, hsg_fps.c): Main_Tick: renderer rate multiplier on every tick [JP 1.27; US 1.03 line 0x0001B7A8]
fps (HSG_FPS, hsg_fps.c): Main_Tick: renderer rate = 30 * M (M = 1 / steps this frame, from hsg_fps.c) [JP 1.27; US 1.03 line 0x0001B7CC]
fps (HSG_FPS, hsg_fps.c): Renderer_WaitVBlankAndFlip: interval 30/fps - 1: flip on every vblank at the 30 FPS setting [JP 1.27; US 1.03 line 0x008CF894]
fps (HSG_FPS, hsg_fps.c): Main_Render: lis r9,0x190 (was extsw r9,r9 of S+1; the S+1 / D conversion below is now dead) [JP 1.27; US 1.03 line 0x00019528]
fps (HSG_FPS, hsg_fps.c): Main_Render: phase 4 fraction f1 = lfs 0x18FFFF0 (draw fraction from hsg_fps.c, was fdivs (S+1)/D) [JP 1.27; US 1.03 line 0x00019554]
fps (HSG_FPS, hsg_fps.c): Main_Tick: lis r9,0x190 (was extsw r9,r9 of S+1; the S+1 / D conversion below is now dead) [JP 1.27; US 1.03 line 0x0001B65C]
fps (HSG_FPS, hsg_fps.c): Main_Tick: phase 3 fraction f1 = lfs 0x18FFFF0 (draw fraction from hsg_fps.c, was fdivs (S+1)/D) [JP 1.27; US 1.03 line 0x0001B68C]

fps (HSG_FPS, hsg_fps.c): renderer effect-timer step 0x90DC18: skip threshold f29 = lfs 0xDAC414 (was 0.0); 1e30 on frames that close no stock 30 Hz frame, so its per-call countdowns keep the stock rate [JP 1.27; US 1.03 line 0x0090DC3C]
